title: Stop The Wedding!
hook: Complete sung chorus, both statements: a held low pickup, a rising answer, then a stepwise descent, repeated with the same closing high note held long

title: 500 Miles
hook: Complete verse melody in D major, both stanzas: the rising D-D-F#-F#-E-D-F# line and its answer down to B, the A-B-D-E lift held on E, then the repeated refrain stanza ending on the held tonic D (54 attacks, about 64 beats)

Reference: Atlantic Notes tutorial (bM6GEoOD-nI) frame roll, 54/54 events at one constant shift (0), onsets within 0.5075 beat after a free linear tempo fit. Third: Benjamin Soudan tutorial (rk9nRoe34pw) pairs every unmerged event (three merged same-key attacks). Dissent: TutorialsByHugo and Peter PlutaX omit the A3 attacks at events 21 and 49; three sources against two, recorded in the discrepancies. Source families plausibly independent but unproven.
